title: Tangent spaces of an embedded C¹ submanifold contained in a subspace A₀ are m-dimensional subspaces of A₀ (parent step 1)
statement: Tangent spaces lie in A₀. Data: P, m ∈ ℕ; a linear subspace A₀ ⊆ ℝ^P; M ⊆ ℝ^P. Hypotheses: M is an embedded C¹ m-dimensional submanifold of ℝ^P (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M: every y ∈ M has open V ⊆ ℝ^m, open W ∋ y and ψ : ℝ^m → ℝ^P, C¹ and injective on V, with ψ(V) = W ∩ M, V ∩ ψ⁻¹(K) compact for compact K ⊆ W, and Dψ(z) injective for z ∈ V) and M ⊆ A₀. Conclusion: for every x ∈ M there is a linear subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^P whose underlying set is tangentSpace M x = {γ'(0) : γ C¹ on (−1, 1), γ((−1, 1)) ⊆ M, γ(0) = x}, with dim Q = m and Q ⊆ A₀.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → ∀ x ∈ M, ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), (Q : Set (Euclid P)) = tangentSpace M x ∧ Module.finrank ℝ Q = m ∧ Q ≤ A₀
